These findings are used as baseline for Log Streaming load testing and to figure out what is should be the Log Aggregator PV size.

 - Multiline log support effort for FluentBit configured in NDB helm chart.
 - Done removing "others" permission from mounted _*logs*_ and {_}*diagnostics*{_}. 
 - MSP team removed additional JSON wrapper from the log lines on Log Aggregator PV in this PR: [https://github.com/nutanix-core/msp-controller/pull/5916.] From the next release (or in current master version) we will be able to consume SMSP collected logs as is. 
 - Adaptation of NDB API service diagnostic bundle generation flow is under development.
 -- Changes for triggering Logbay collection for NDB SMSP logs from API Service are merged into master. It allows us to trigger the log collection for all SMSP clusters that contain ntnx-ndb namespace. Further granularity (specification of SMSP cluster uuid) and downloading of collected logs is under development.

This effort will need revisiting, because we need to use dedicated optional argument for SMSP cluster UUID described in following item. 
 - NCC team raised the problem with missing ability on Logbay to map optional arguments with tags. That means we need to create dedicated optional argument for NDB instead of reusing existing optional arg for passing SMSP cluster UUID for log collection. Fix merged.
 - NCC team finished extension of API to support NDB tag optional arguments: [ENG-796290|https://jira.nutanix.com/browse/ENG-796290]

Summary: API server logging for NDB control plane deployed on SMSP : Kick-Off
Status Update:
h1. 19/Feb
 - Engineering side approved the design document and QA should do the review process.
 - NCC / LogBay dependency - The required approvals have been granted from V4 API team and NCC team confirmed change commitment for Iris release. With this change we would be able to collect logs for the specific SMSP cluster. This is important, so we can reduce log bundle size and time needed to collect logs
 - Existing NCC/Logbay flow - Tested and verified that with the current Logbay API state we can trigger log collection and download the collected logs but only for all MSP clusters controlled by single PC. In other words, we don't have possibility to collect and download logs only for the SMSP cluster where NDB CP is deployed
 - Created one more ticket for MSP team for the ability to configure formatter on Log Aggregator (Fluentd). MSP team confirmed to create formatter for Fluentd which will not create wrapper around log lines.
 - Proved that Log Streaming architecture can suffice NDB needs. More details at the [Performance test document|https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HSbfD9CNxzFFRriflSgZ30a8X_Z_m5fqSOBqpFiidyE/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.uswpmtadazz6]. 
 - Deployed Objects lite on testing SMSP cluster in order to figure out how it fits into Diag Bundle generation workflow. It looks really promising, because we would got out of the box objects lifecycle and retention policies (to periodically clean old diag budnles) and load off the NDB API service to temporarily  keep the whole Diag Bundle content (which could be huge depending the number of collecting machines (DBs)). We are currently waiting on PM decision ([https://jira.nutanix.com/browse/ERA-54373]) about Objects lite introduction into NDB on SMSP deployment. We decided to keep supporting the merging the log archives on NDB API Service temp FS and solve the potential risk of disk overflow with multiple DB Server archives size by limiting the diagnostics directory size. Objects lite will stay for future improvement and north star for diag bundle generation. 
 - Agreed with MSP team to increase PV size of Log Aggregator in case of necessity (make it configurable), instead of configuring Scavenger to have custom retention periods for different log types. [NDB log analysis |https://confluence.eng.nutanix.com:8443/spaces/~vladimir.stankovic/pages/460993569/ERA-54927+Log+Aggregator+PV+Size]showed that we need about 72 GB per month for log collection for NDB API Server, so the default size of SMSP log aggregator's PV will be enough for NDB API Service's logs. On the other hand, when we include newly introduced services like Spire (cert management), Victoria Metrics, NATS, ... we will probably need extra capacity for logs which will be able to be set by pending MSP feature. We need to create log amount assessment once we have all NDB CP services deployed on SMSP.
 - Need to figure out how to handle multi namespace of logging infrastructure problem. In short, the main part of MSP provided log infra is outside the NDB namespace which makes the DR (by NDK) more complicated. It is decided to go without NDK support for initial release.
